create_inverse_sqrt_lr_scheduler: create an InverseSquareRootSchedule LR scheduler with warmup and inverse square root decay for an optimizer
configure_warmup_updates: configure the warmup-updates argument to linearly warmup the learning rate for the first N updates
configure_warmup_init_lr: configure the warmup-init-lr argument to set the initial learning rate during the warmup phase
step_update_lr: call step_update on InverseSquareRootSchedule to update the learning rate after each training update step
register_inverse_sqrt_scheduler: register the inverse_sqrt LR scheduler with fairseq using the register_lr_scheduler decorator
